suites.name: text-plate-v2
suites.protocol: Live API call; local CadQuery execution, positive-volume single solid, STEP/STL export and HTML viewer. No reference-geometry accuracy score.
suites.command: agentic-cad generate --prompt "A mounting plate 60 by 40 by 5 mm with one centered 10 mm diameter through-hole. Use editable length, width, thickness and hole diameter parameters." --output work/text-plate

suites.name: photo-block
suites.protocol: Live API call; local CadQuery execution, positive-volume single solid, STEP/STL export and HTML viewer. No reference-geometry accuracy score.
suites.command: agentic-cad generate sample_data/public_benchmark_v2/block/views/view_000.png --prompt "Reconstruct the blue rectangular block in the reference photo as a single CAD solid. Use length 60 mm, width 40 mm, height 30 mm. Ignore background." --output work/photo-block

suites.name: multiview-bracket
suites.protocol: Live API call; local CadQuery execution, positive-volume single solid, STEP/STL export and HTML viewer. No reference-geometry accuracy score.
suites.command: agentic-cad generate --image sample_data/public_benchmark_v2/l_bracket/views/view_000.png --image sample_data/public_benchmark_v2/l_bracket/views/view_003.png --image sample_data/public_benchmark_v2/l_bracket/views/view_006.png --image sample_data/public_benchmark_v2/l_bracket/views/view_009.png --prompt "Reconstruct the blue L-shaped bracket from these four views. Overall longest dimension is 60 mm. Preserve the L profile and visible cutouts. Other dimensions may be estimated." --output work/bracket
